name: Austria — Austrian parties
intro: compare it with Austrian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Austria: those represented in the parliament (Nationalrat) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Nationalrat) after the 2024 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 183 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

KPÖ.name: Kommunistische Partei Österreichs
KPÖ.priorities: Affordable housing, Cost of living, Public services
KPÖ.description: Communist party that has revived through a focus on housing, running the city of Graz since 2021; it polls near the 4% threshold nationally.

Grüne.name: Die Grünen
Grüne.priorities: Climate action, Rule of law, Civil liberties
Grüne.description: Austria's green party, junior partner in government from 2020 to 2025, focused on climate protection, transparency and fighting corruption.

SPÖ.name: Sozialdemokratische Partei Österreichs
SPÖ.priorities: Workers' rights and wages, Public healthcare, Taxing wealth, Affordable housing
SPÖ.description: Austria's social democrats, in government with the ÖVP and NEOS since 2025; under Andreas Babler they call for wealth and inheritance taxes and a shorter working week.

Volt.name: Volt Österreich
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

NEOS.name: NEOS – Das Neue Österreich
NEOS.priorities: Education, Fiscal discipline, Deeper European integration, Rule of law
NEOS.description: Liberal party, in government since 2025, pushing education reform, pension reform, transparency and deeper European integration.

ÖVP.name: Österreichische Volkspartei
ÖVP.priorities: Reducing immigration, Competitiveness and growth, Fiscal discipline, Security and law and order
ÖVP.description: Christian-democratic People's Party, which leads the government under Chancellor Christian Stocker; it favours tight asylum rules, low taxes and business-friendly policies.

FPÖ.name: Freiheitliche Partei Österreichs
FPÖ.ideologies: National conservatism, Right-wing populism, Anti-immigration, Euroscepticism
FPÖ.priorities: Remigration and closed borders, National sovereignty, Military neutrality, Cost of living
FPÖ.description: Radical-right Freedom Party, first in the 2024 election with its best result ever; it calls for 'remigration', an end to sanctions on Russia and strict neutrality.
